alt: Three cans of 'Good Nut' organic coconut water — Tom Brady's new beverage brand — displayed side by side in original, chocolate, and sparkling varieties
story: Tom Brady launched an organic coconut water brand called 'Good Nut' via Gopuff on June 8, 2026 — going to such elaborate lengths to avoid saying the product's own name in the launch video that he stops himself every time he's about to say it, even though the cans were already printed.
why_funny: A seven-time Super Bowl champion named his health drink 'Good Nut,' filmed a whole ad where he refuses to say its name, and shipped the cans anyway.
